← Open Slate Forge

Your documents, on this browser

Slate Forge is a public-beta word processor. Write, format, add images and tables, and export copies without an application account.

Keep a separate backup. Saving on this device does not upload or sync your documents. Clearing browser data, private browsing, device loss or storage eviction can remove them.

Start writing

  1. Write in the document and give it a title. Use File → New document for a template.
  2. Check the save status near the title. File → Save on this device (Ctrl/⌘ + S) waits for saving to finish.
  3. Use File → Open a file to import supported text, HTML, DOCX or ODT files. Review imported formatting before relying on it.

Save an independent copy

  • File → Export document creates HTML, DOCX, ODT or plain-text copies. Use the resulting Save link to download the file.
  • File → Export workspace backup creates a ZIP containing documents, history, trash, saved PDF edits and OCR drafts. Restore it through File → Open a file.
  • File → Encrypted workspace backup protects a complete backup with a password. Keep that password separately; it cannot be reset.
  • On a shared browser profile, other people can open ordinary saved work. End session removes this workspace's device copy. Downloaded files and optional locked recovery copies remain.

Moving from another address or device

Browser documents belong to the address and browser profile where you created them. Before moving from the original Slate Forge Site to GitHub Pages, export a complete workspace backup there, save the file, then import it at the new address. Compare the restored documents and PDF/OCR content before removing the original copy.

Offline and installed use

Open the app online first. Tools → App status reports offline availability. Use Tools → Offline preparation to download PDF/OCR components before disconnecting. Browsers can still remove cached files. Installation, file sharing and operating-system file handling depend on the browser.

What to expect in the beta

Continuous editing is the default. Paged editing, complex layouts, review tools, PDF tools and OCR need extra care: inspect exported results and keep originals. Exact Word/ODT layout and complex nested wrapping remain incomplete. PDF tools can replace supported text in place using existing glyphs or a local replacement font; full content reflow and vertical text remain incomplete. Replacement is not redaction. XFA supports bound fields, multiple selections, a limited local calculation/script interpreter and explicit reviewed submissions; advanced or conflicting bindings and scripts may be refused. Native Word drawing export supports bounded editable shapes, text and groups, with limits on effects and typography. ODT supports ordinary content and bounded column/orientation sections; complex nested sections and page-design changes can differ across readers. OCR text needs correction. Nested DOCX suggestions retain the full tree for Slate Forge; Word shows the outer native review layer. Some exports require decisions on pending structural changes first. Certificate signatures check supported byte integrity; certificate trust and revocation are not established. Timestamp attachment requires a matching authority response and selected trusted roots; LTV/archive evidence remains unfinished.

For printing, use File → Print / Save as PDF, inspect the page preview and its warnings, then choose 100% print scale and disable browser-added headers and footers.

If something goes wrong

  • For a save warning, keep the tab open and export a workspace backup before reloading.
  • If a complete backup fails, the app offers an explicitly text-only emergency JSON export. Export PDF files separately where possible.
  • If the editor will not load, reconnect and try reloading. Do not clear this site's data as a troubleshooting step until you have independent backups.
  • When reporting an issue, include the browser, operating system and steps to reproduce it. Use a small non-sensitive sample instead of a private document.

Report a problem or suggest an improvement on GitHub

No application account, paid service or cloud document storage is required. Documents and exports are processed on your device.
